purpose: First real 100-entry source-attested Khasi human-review corpus
source_attestation_scope: headword occurrence in a Khasi part-of-speech category
presence in Wiktionary IPA category where marked
presence in Wiktionary usage-example category where marked
compound or multiword category membership where marked
known_spelling_review_case: pyniap should be compared with separately attested pynïap before a canonical decision
promotion_rule: No batch row may become verified until the KhasiLex v0.4 editorial policy's human-review and provenance gates are satisfied.
